description: Two young boys sit side by side on ornate silver thrones in a dark, gilded hall. The boy on the left wears a jeweled crown and a heavy gold-and-jewel brocade robe, and the boy on the right wears a silver-and-gold robe and holds a scepter. A veiled, dark-clad woman peeks out from a half-open door between the thrones, and bearded men in kaftans stand in the shadows at the sides. Double-headed eagle emblems are carved on the thrones' high backs and hang on the wall above. There are no visible letters, and the painting runs edge to edge.
